title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Issuing the Several Opinions on Establishing a Long-term Working Mechanism for the Funding Guarantee and Financial Management of People's Courts
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Notice on Issuing the Several Opinions on Establishing a Long-Term Working Mechanism for Court Funding Guarantee and Financial Management

Fa Fa [2012] No. 21

High People's Courts of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the High People's Court of Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region; and the Intermediate People's Courts of all cities under separate state planning:

The Supreme People's Court's Several Opinions on Establishing a Long-Term Working Mechanism for Court Funding Guarantee and Financial Management are hereby issued to you. Please implement them earnestly.

October 31, 2012

Several Opinions on Establishing a Long-Term Working Mechanism for Court Funding Guarantee and Financial Management

To meet the requirements of the reform of the political-legal funding guarantee system and fiscal reform under the new circumstances, to further strengthen financial work, standardize financial management, improve the capacity for funding guarantee, fully leverage the efficiency of fund utilization, and effectively ensure the smooth progress of all work centered on the trial and enforcement of courts, in accordance with the Opinions on Strengthening Political-Legal Funding Guarantee Work (Ting Zi [2009] No. 32) issued by the General Office of the CPC Central Committee and the General Office of the State Council, and the Accounting Law of the PRC and other relevant regulations, we now put forward the following opinions on establishing a long-term working mechanism for court funding guarantee and financial management:

1. Fully Recognize the Important Significance of Establishing a Long-Term Working Mechanism for Funding Guarantee and Financial Management

(1) Funding guarantee is an important foundation for courts to perform their statutory trial functions and achieve their own scientific development. At present, China is at a critical stage of building a moderately prosperous society in all respects. The mission of courts to promote the implementation of laws and maintain social fairness and justice is becoming more arduous, and the tasks of participating in social management and maintaining social harmony and stability are becoming heavier. The central government has continuously introduced reform measures to strengthen funding guarantee, effectively alleviating various guarantee-related difficulties that have plagued courts. However, the contradiction between the supply and demand of court funding remains acute. Establishing a long-term working mechanism for funding guarantee and financial management is a major initiative to adapt to reform and development requirements, enhance the level of funding guarantee, and promote the healthy, stable, and sustainable development of court undertakings.

(2) Financial management is an important means to standardize court funding guarantee and effectively ensure the normal operation of all court work. With the economic and social development, the acceleration of the rule of law process, and the advancement of the judicial system reform, especially the deepening of fiscal reform and the political-legal funding guarantee system reform, the intensity of court funding guarantee has gradually increased, financial transactions have become increasingly frequent, and the tasks and requirements of financial management work have become heavier and higher. Compared with the financial work tasks they undertake and the requirements of trial work, the basic state of court financial management shows a clear gap, which seriously restricts the in-depth development of various reforms in funding guarantee and financial management. Establishing a long-term working mechanism for funding guarantee and financial management is an effective way to improve and implement various measures for funding guarantee and financial management, and is the key to promoting the construction of a scientific, refined, standardized, and institutionalized court financial work system.

(3) Funding guarantee and financial management, as the two major functions of financial work, are important components of court work and important guarantees for promoting the scientific development of court work. Courts at all levels must further properly position financial work, recognize and plan financial work from the perspective of improving judicial capacity and establishing the authority of the socialist rule of law, and fully understand the importance of strengthening financial work and establishing a long-term working mechanism for funding guarantee and financial management under the new circumstances. In accordance with the principle of "strong guarantee, standardized management, solid foundation, and efficient operation," a long-term working mechanism for funding guarantee and financial management shall be established that not only complies with national laws, regulations, and related policy requirements, but also enables financial work to fully play its role as a staff assistant, comprehensive management, and guarantee leader in courts, effectively ensuring the needs of courts in performing their trial functions, and strongly promoting the construction and development of court undertakings. Taking fiscal reform and the political-legal funding guarantee system reform as an opportunity, with the primary goal of serving and obeying the central work of trial and enforcement, actively adapting to the requirements of judicial system reform, deeply studying and exploring the inherent laws of court funding guarantee and financial management under the new circumstances, continuously overcoming and solving practical difficulties and problems in financial work, and comprehensively advancing the construction of a long-term working mechanism for funding guarantee and financial management.

2. Strengthen Research on Financial Policies and Systems, Advance the Institutionalization of Funding Guarantee and Financial Management

(4) Implement funding guarantee policies. We must actively promote department budget reform, explore the establishment of a standardized and unified court budget management system, and an operational working mechanism where budget preparation and budget execution, financial approval and financial supervision, funding needs and funding use, and financial management and asset management mutually promote, mutually constrain, and are mutually separated. We must deeply advance the reform of the funding guarantee system, proactively coordinate with relevant departments to improve various funding guarantee systems, coordinate the formulation of detailed rules for daily review work such as performance evaluation of system funding input, tracking and review of project investment benefits, and supervision and inspection of special funds, implement the full funding guarantee responsibilities of governments at all levels and departments such as finance and development and reform, promote the reasonable allocation, timely allocation, and scientific use of various funds, and fully leverage the efficiency of fund use.

(5) Determine funding guarantee standards. Based on the classified guarantee policy implemented by the political-legal funding guarantee system reform, we must strengthen research on the scope, standards, and reasonableness of various expenditure items of courts, and gradually form a stable and standardized funding guarantee system. We must establish and improve a normal growth mechanism for court public funding, strive to achieve that the standard for daily operation public funding is determined according to central government requirements, and the standard for case-handling business funding is determined according to court case-handling costs, and make timely adjustments as work conditions and case-handling costs change. Based on court equipment allocation standards, office space construction standards for party and government organs, and people's tribunal construction standards, combining factors such as local price levels and project construction costs of political-legal infrastructure, scientifically calculate and determine the standards for business equipment funding and infrastructure construction funding, ensuring that the funding guarantee standards are coordinated and unified with relevant construction standards.

(6) Improve financial rules and regulations. We must carefully study and master national laws, regulations, and relevant policy requirements on funding guarantee and financial management, keenly grasp the business needs and development characteristics of court undertakings, carefully organize and scientifically formulate financial rules and regulations. Important financial rules and regulations shall be formulated in the form of court documents to establish the authority of financial systems. We must objectively analyze the implementation of financial rules and regulations, focus on studying and solving issues that concern and attract the attention of court staff, optimize management processes, close management loopholes in systems, and timely improve, adjust, and clean up unreasonable financial rules and regulations. We must pay attention to the continuity, consistency, and systematization of systems, ensure that comprehensive and specific financial systems are coordinated and complementary, and that system-level and court-level financial systems cooperate and support each other, striving to achieve the goal of institutionalizing, standardizing, and systematizing court funding guarantee and financial management.

3. Accelerate the Construction of Financial Institutions, Advance the Standardization of Funding Guarantee and Financial Management

(7) Scientifically set up financial institutions. Courts at all levels must establish and improve financial institutions, ensuring that the departments for funding management, matter management, and funding use are independent of each other, and that the institutions or positions for budget preparation, execution, and supervision are separated from each other. The Logistics and Equipment Department of the Supreme People's Court shall set up a Planning and Finance Division and an Authority Finance Division; the Logistics and Equipment Departments of High People's Courts shall set up a Planning and Finance Section (Division) and an Authority Finance Section (Division); the Logistics and Equipment Departments of Intermediate People's Courts shall set up a Finance Section (Office); Basic People's Courts shall assign full-time financial personnel to be responsible for financial work, and Basic People's Courts with the conditions may set up a Finance Section (Office) within the Logistics and Equipment Department. The financial activities of People's Tribunals shall be managed by the financial department of the court to which they belong.

(8) Clarify the responsibilities of financial institutions. The Planning and Finance Division (Section) of High People's Courts and above is mainly responsible for researching, formulating, organizing, and implementing funding guarantee policies and comprehensive financial systems for the court system; cooperating with the finance, development and reform, and other departments in the allocation, issuance, and management of central and provincial transfer payment funds and capital construction investment funds for the court system; guiding and supervising the financial work of lower-level courts; organizing professional training for financial personnel; and responsible for the preparation of the court's budget plan, control of budget execution, compilation of final accounts, formulation of comprehensive financial systems, and guidance of financial management. The Authority Finance Division (Section) is mainly responsible for the execution of the court's budget, daily financial management, formulation of individual financial systems, and the specific implementation and execution of funding expenditure policies. The Finance Section (Office) of Intermediate People's Courts is responsible for the court's own financial work and for guiding and supervising the financial work of lower-level courts and subordinate units.

(9) Implement centralized management of financial affairs. Courts at all levels must scientifically divide financial work functions, clarify financial management rights and responsibilities. All financial activities and various types of funds shall be managed centrally by the financial department. Non-financial departments are strictly prohibited from undertaking financial responsibilities. The financial department must conscientiously perform its responsibilities for budget management, revenue and expenditure management, asset management, current fund management, financial accounting, financial supervision, and other related financial duties. Departments related to financial work must strengthen work coordination and cooperation with the financial department, each performing its own duties and taking its own responsibilities according to management rights and responsibilities. When any department carries out matters involving financial work, it shall first seek the opinion of the financial department. The financial department is responsible for organizing guidance, tracking effectiveness, and supervising and inspecting matters involving financial work within the court.

(10) Standardize the setting of financial institutions. The method, number, name, and responsibilities of financial institutions set up by courts at all levels must be standardized and unified, and adjusted and determined in accordance with the requirements of this Opinion. The setting procedure must be standardized and rigorous, proposed by the Logistics and Equipment Department of the court, reviewed and approved by the Organization and Personnel Department, and approved by the Party Group, and reported to the Logistics and Equipment Department of the higher-level court for recordation. Once the financial institution and its responsibilities are determined, they shall not be adjusted arbitrarily. If adjustment is truly necessary, it must be confirmed by the Organization and Personnel Department of the court and approved by the Party Group, and reported to the Logistics and Equipment Department of the higher-level court for recordation. Courts at all levels shall complete the adjustment of financial institutions and their responsibilities within one year after the issuance of this Opinion.

4. Strictly Staff Financial Personnel, Advance the Professionalization of Funding Guarantee and Financial Management

(11) Reasonably staff financial personnel. Courts at all levels must, based on the requirements of financial positions, the establishment of personnel, and the volume of business work, staff sufficient full-time financial personnel and a certain number of financial personnel with professional technical titles. The setting of financial work positions shall adhere to the principle of separation of incompatible duties, ensuring clear rights and responsibilities among positions, mutual restraint, and mutual supervision. The Finance Section (Division) of High People's Courts shall be staffed with no fewer than five full-time financial personnel; Intermediate People's Courts shall be staffed with no fewer than three full-time financial personnel; Basic People's Courts shall be staffed with no fewer than two full-time financial personnel. The number of financial personnel shall be increased in a timely manner as the volume of financial work increases. Courts where the number of financial personnel has not reached the minimum staffing standard shall complete the staffing within three years.

(12) Establish a chief accountant system. We must staff high-quality, high-level full-time financial management personnel to be responsible for financial skills guidance and participate in the management of internal financial affairs. High People's Courts and above with the conditions may set up one chief accountant. The chief accountant shall hold a position from the deputy level to the full level of the Logistics and Equipment Department of the same court, assisting the leader in charge of the Logistics and Equipment Department in organizing and implementing economic accounting and financial accounting work, including the court's accounting basic management, budget management, cost accounting, construction of internal financial control mechanisms, supervision of major financial matters, professional training and assessment of financial personnel, etc.; participating in the decision-making of important economic activities of the court; providing professional guidance and supervision of the financial work of the courts under its jurisdiction. The chief accountant shall be nominated by the Logistics and Equipment Department, appointed by the Organization and Personnel Department, and reported to the superior competent department for recordation. The chief accountant shall not be removed arbitrarily. If removal is truly necessary, the change shall be promptly reported to the superior competent department for recordation.

(13) Select and staff financial personnel on a merit basis. We must select and staff specialized personnel who understand finance and are good at management to engage in financial work. In terms of professional quality, the selected chief accountant must possess the necessary policy level and professional theoretical knowledge, understand court trials and other work, be familiar with national financial laws, regulations, guidelines, policies, and systems, grasp the characteristics of court financial work and the financial management situation of the system, and have certain organizational, management, and coordination abilities. The financial personnel selected for planning and financial management positions must possess professional financial knowledge, have certain comprehensive research and analysis capabilities, innovation and communication and coordination abilities, and a high level of written expression. The financial personnel selected for authority financial management positions must possess professional accounting knowledge, have operational skills in relevant work positions, and be good at managing funds. In terms of qualifications, the selected chief accountant must have obtained a professional technical qualification of intermediate accountant or above (including intermediate accountant) and have worked as a financial accountant in charge of a unit or an important aspect of a unit for no less than three years. The selected financial personnel must have obtained an accounting qualification certificate. The reimbursing officers of courts implementing centralized accounting shall be full-time financial personnel.

(14) Fully staff financial personnel. Courts at all levels must include the selection and staffing of financial personnel as an important agenda item of the Organization and Personnel Department, seriously organize its implementation, and gradually complete it. Important financial positions shall be held by full-time financial personnel, striving to build a high-quality, professional financial work team. Courts without full-time financial personnel shall, as soon as possible, add full-time personnel with professional accounting knowledge and business skills. We must boldly introduce high-quality financial talent. According to the needs of financial work, the introduction of specialized financial talent shall be included in the court's recruitment plan, with priority given to staffing, and excellent financial talent shall be selected and assigned to suitable financial positions. The main method of selection and staffing is to recruit college graduates with undergraduate degrees or above in finance and economics, supplemented by the selection and transfer of individual business backbone personnel.

5. Strengthen Financial Education and Training, Advance the Professionalization of Funding Guarantee and Financial Management

(15) Innovate financial training mechanisms. Courts at all levels must include the education and training of financial personnel in the assessment and evaluation system of the financial talent team, and comprehensively establish and improve a new training and management mechanism integrating cultivation, management, and use. We must persist in focusing on effectively developing court human resources, guide financial personnel to establish a learning concept, strengthen self-cultivation, actively create conditions for participating in financial business learning, and provide necessary guarantees in terms of learning opportunities, learning time, and learning funds. We must timely arrange for financial personnel to participate in continuing accounting education and professional training organized by superior competent departments and relevant departments such as finance, organize business exchanges and participation in academic activities, and encourage participation in finance and economics degree education and accounting professional title and other business skill examinations. We must attach importance to and strengthen the selection and training of senior financial talent. When conditions are ripe, organize the selection of financial business backbone personnel with certain conditions to study, investigate, and learn at relevant institutions or higher financial and economic institutions at home and abroad, or in Hong Kong, Macao, and Taiwan, focusing on cultivating and reserving high-level, compound financial management specialized talent.

(16) Broaden the forms of financial training. Superior courts must strengthen guidance on financial training, increase the intensity of financial training, and include financial training in the court's annual training plan, with no fewer than one training session per year. Financial training must be regarded as an important responsibility of the training management department, while fully leveraging the functional role of the National Judges College and provincial and municipal (prefecture) three-level training institutions to help financial personnel improve their professional level. Through organizing training by session, level, and region, as well as entrusting key financial and economic institutions and training institutions to carry out systematic rotation training of financial personnel nationwide, we must strive to expand the coverage of financial training. Through joint education, distance education, organizing lecture tours, and key topic seminars, leverage the respective advantages of different training methods to effectively meet the training needs of financial personnel at different levels and in different positions, striving to form a multi-level, multi-channel financial education and training pattern for courts, and promote the overall improvement of the professional quality of financial personnel.

(17) Upgrade the level of financial training. We must expand the scope of financial training, including major leaders of intermediate and basic courts, leaders in charge of finance at all levels, and department heads as targets of financial training, conduct financial knowledge training, enhance the awareness of law-based financial management among court leaders at all levels, and organize high-level financial training in a targeted manner. On the basis of ensuring that financial personnel master the necessary financial business knowledge and practical skills, enrich the content of financial personnel business training, and focus on strengthening the theoretical learning and comprehensive quality cultivation of financial personnel. Combining the characteristics of court financial work, through financial training, not only improve the level of professional theory, but also enhance policy theory literacy and enrich basic legal knowledge; not only improve business operation skills, but also cultivate financial management ability, comprehensive analysis ability, and innovation ability; not only focus on professional quality, but also further strengthen work style, financial discipline, and integrity education, prompting financial personnel to fulfill their duties, manage finances according to law, be honest and self-disciplined, and provide high-quality and efficient services, playing a more active role for trial and enforcement work.

6. Optimize Financial Work Mechanisms, Advance the Systematization of Funding Guarantee and Financial Management

(18) Establish and improve a law-based financial management mechanism. According to relevant national laws and regulations, standardize the financial work mechanism and actively organize its implementation. Courts at all levels must implement a system of "one-pen approval" for funding expenditures. Financial matters shall be approved step by step from the bottom up. The specific handling financial department or financial personnel shall first put forward review opinions, report step by step to the leader in charge of finance for approval or signature of opinions before submission for approval. Major expenditure projects or financial matters must be discussed and decided collectively. We must implement all-round linkage management of financial matters, forming a collaborative working mechanism where the financial functional department takes the lead, the funding demand department demonstrates and proposes and is responsible for execution, the relevant unified management department conducts prior review and evaluation, and the internal audit department conducts post-event supervision. The financial department and financial personnel must lead by example, consciously enhance the awareness of strict management, and perform their duties in accordance with laws and regulations. Matters that comply with financial regulations must be handled promptly without undue delay or shirking. For matters that violate regulations, they have the right to refuse to handle them or correct them according to their authority. For policy documents involving financial matters but without prior consultation with the financial department, they shall not be implemented. No department or individual may circumvent financial supervision in any way, exceed authority in management or approval, or instigate, instruct, or force financial institutions and financial personnel to handle financial matters in violation of regulations, let alone retaliate against financial personnel who perform their duties according to regulations in any way or under any pretext. Financial personnel who achieve remarkable results in maintaining national financial discipline and financial work shall be rewarded according to relevant regulations. Financial personnel who violate financial discipline and financial systems, neglect their duties, causing losses to state property or work, shall be punished according to laws and regulations.

19. Establish and improve a scientific leadership working mechanism. People's courts at all levels shall strengthen leadership over financial work. The Party leadership group shall regularly hear reports on financial work and annual budget work, seriously study, discuss, and decide on major issues in financial work, promptly assist in resolving key and difficult problems in financial work, coordinate with relevant departments to cooperate in financial work, and guide all departments and all police officers to strictly implement various financial systems and policies, actively creating a favorable working environment for financial work. They shall enhance the foresight, planning, and procedural nature of financial work, reduce ad hoc motions, ensure the seriousness of financial decisions, and eliminate arbitrariness in financial decision-making and expenditures. They shall adhere to and improve democratic centralism, strictly implement a system of division of responsibilities under collective leadership, select and strengthen the leadership of financial departments, and gradually professionalize the leadership responsible for financial affairs. They shall support financial departments and financial personnel in lawfully performing their financial duties, encourage and protect financial departments and financial personnel in adhering to principles and exercising bold management, and care about the growth and progress of financial personnel. They shall establish and improve relevant financial decision-making procedures, rules of procedure, and working systems. Leaders at all levels shall strictly perform their duties, correctly exercise their authority, lead by example, set a good example, and actively take effective measures to ensure the implementation of various financial rules and regulations.

20. Establish and improve a guidance and supervision working mechanism. People's courts at all levels shall, by strengthening the construction and management of internal control mechanisms, form a working mechanism with clear powers and responsibilities, mutual checks, and mutual supervision among different institutions and positions. The internal accounting control mechanism shall cover all economic business matters involving accounting work within the court and related positions, restrain all personnel within the court involved in financial work, and, focusing on key control points in the business process, be implemented in all links such as decision-making, execution, supervision, and feedback. Financial institutions and financial personnel at all levels of people's courts shall, in accordance with respective job responsibilities, approval authority, and requirements of relevant financial and economic systems, review, approve, and promptly handle financial matters, strictly implement accounting supervision, proactively provide financial guidance, and coordinate to resolve issues of funding guarantees and financial management in various departments. The organizational and personnel departments and the discipline inspection and supervision departments shall focus on daily assessment and supervision, strengthen the inspection, supervision, and management of the ideological, political, disciplinary, and work style conditions of financial institutions and financial personnel. Higher-level courts shall strengthen guidance, supervision, and inspection of the financial work of lower-level courts, incorporate inspection results into comprehensive evaluation content, and may, when necessary, organize financial inspections. They shall, through financial guidance and supervision of lower-level courts and subordinate units, improve system fund and capital management, strengthen research on financial policies and systems, standardize system financial management, and improve work efficiency. They shall consciously accept the supervision, inspection, and audit of financial and auditing departments. Intermediate people's courts and above with appropriate conditions may set up audit institutions or designate dedicated personnel to strengthen internal audit work.

21. Establish and improve a performance evaluation working mechanism. They shall strictly follow performance evaluation procedures, refine evaluation indicators, implement evaluation measures, conduct scientific performance evaluations on fund efficiency, effectiveness, and management quality, and link the results of performance evaluation with personal progress and growth. In accordance with the requirements of the scientific development concept and the correct view of performance, and based on the job responsibilities and work characteristics of financial positions, with work performance as the main basis and factors such as moral character, knowledge, ability, integrity, work style, etc., as constituent elements, they shall establish a scientific evaluation system for financial institutions and personnel. They shall regard financial professionals as high-quality human resources, improve the occupational protection of accounting professionals, and encourage financial personnel to love their jobs and devote themselves to their work. They shall care about the growth and progress of financial personnel politically, and select excellent financial talents with outstanding evaluation results for financial leadership and related leadership positions. They shall implement rank and treatment policies. For in-service financial personnel with accounting professional technical titles, people's courts at all levels may, with reference to relevant policy standards and corresponding judge ranks, implement corresponding occupational protection treatment. For those who have been engaged in financial work for more than 20 years, priority may be given to resolving their rank based on merit. They shall maintain the relative stability of financial personnel, enhance the sense of responsibility and honor of financial personnel, and prevent abnormal turnover of financial personnel. Financial personnel who are unqualified shall be immediately transferred from their financial positions and reappointed.
